name: crux-growth-skills
description: Growth skills for ecommerce brands by gocrux.io, best with a Crux Growth Brain connected. Plan Black Friday on your own data, audit your landing pages, diagnose why a KPI moved between two periods, and review last month.

interface.shortDescription: Crux Black Friday planning, landing page audits, performance diagnosis and monthly reviews
interface.longDescription: Plan Black Friday on your own data: read last year, test your November and December targets against it, and agree a plan with day-by-day targets you can download. Audit a landing page from its URL, or find your weakest pages, with prioritised fixes and a test backlog. Diagnose why a KPI moved between two periods, split into its levers, with the main driver found and what to do about it. Review last month in a deck across trading, acquisition, retention and LTV, and order value and product, with recommendations.
defaultPrompt: Which of my landing pages are underperforming?
Why did my revenue drop last month?
How did last month go? Write my monthly review.
